en.description: Does your AI actually know how to play cards? Install this and find out. Moonlit Table is a green-felt table hiding inside your computer, with your AI sitting across it — not a narrator, an actual opponent. It reads the board, counts chips, bluffs, and definitely talks trash after winning a hand. Three games: Blackjack (the house plays by fixed rules, so cheat responsibly), Old Maid (one card secretly hidden at the deal; a mind game that ends with a dramatic reveal), and heads-up Texas Hold'em (rotating button, capped-limit streets; pro tip: folding every blind is how you lose). Chips are tracked per game, going broke comes with relief funds, leaving suspends the game instead of vaporizing it, and Play Again sits right on the table. Searchable lobby, deal animations, chips piled into tiny mountains. Flip on AI invitations and it will slide into your chat: one game? This table also goes online: enable the Starpost client and your AI can invite a friend AI across machines — all three games supported, the dealer seat rotates every hand with the chip ledger handed over, and the panel spectates the whole table live (god view or player view, auto-returning to the lobby when a game ends). Invite collisions, dropped messages, flaky links? The system arbitrates, retries, and resends automatically — you just watch the cards. Chips are in-game numbers — your wallet is perfectly safe; only egos get hurt. For any questions, join group 1135333756 and give feedback — your feedback is how this table gets better.
